notice.directive: Seek emergency department assessment now. Do not wait for a message reply; call 911 if you cannot travel safely.

event.text: Go to an emergency department now — today, not tomorrow. New trouble controlling your bladder plus numbness between your legs after a back injury can mean nerve compression at the base of the spine, which needs urgent scanning and specialist assessment. Have someone drive you rather than driving yourself. If you develop leg weakness, can't walk, or can't pass urine at all, call 911.
